name: run-trace
description: Keep long-running commands observable: trace runner writes a live log line by line while streaming to the terminal, and hooks flag commands whose output or exit code would be lost.

description_i18n.en: Keep long-running commands observable: trace runner writes a live log line by line while streaming to the terminal, and hooks flag commands whose output or exit code would be lost.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 让长跑命令始终可观测：trace 运行器边跑边落盘同时实时回显，hook 拦住输出或退出码会丢失的写法。
